source_title: Silambarasan and Nayanthara's possible reunion after 10 years in 'Dude' director Keerthiswaran's next spa - The Times of India
source_excerpt: A possible reunion of Nayanthara and Silambarasan has sparked excitement among Tamil cinema fans. The two actors, who last shared screen space in 'Idhu Namma Aalu', may reportedly come together for a new project. If the reports are true, their pairing could be one of the interesting combinations to look forward to in Tamil cinema. The project is said to be directed by Keerthiswaran, who made his directorial debut with Pradeep Ranganathan's 'Dude'. However, the makers are yet to make an official announcement about the film or its cast.According to a report by Cinema Express, Silambarasan will play the lead role in Keerthiswaran's upcoming film, with Nayanthara reportedly being considered for the female lead. She is also said to be playing a police officer in the film. If she comes on board, the project will bring Nayanthara and Silambarasan together on screen after nearly 10 years.Their last film together was Pandiraj's 'Idhu Namma Aalu', which was released in 2016. Before that, they shared screen space in 'Vallavan' (2006). The upcoming film is also expected to mark Silambarasan's return to a police officer's role after 'Osthe' (2011). Reports suggest that shooting could begin in December, although an official confirmation is awaited.Silambarasan's 'Arasan' and Nayanthara's 'Mookuthi Amman 2' keep fans busyMeanwhile, Silambarasan's fans are eagerly awaiting updates on 'Arasan', directed by Vetri Maaran. The film was earlier expected to release during Diwali but has since been postponed. Reports suggest that a special seven-minute video titled 'The World of Arasan' could be released during the festive season.On the other hand, Nayanthara is gearing up for the release of 'Mookuthi Amman 2', directed by Sundar C. The film is among the major Tamil releases expected during the Diwali season. She is also working with Rajinikanth in 'Dharman'.Will Nayanthara and Silambarasan share screen space again?Keerthiswaran's second directorial venture has attracted attention following the response to his debut film, 'Dude', starring Pradeep Ranganathan. There have also been reports about Keerthiswaran directing Jason Sanjay's acting debut. However, the project with Silambarasan is reportedly among his upcoming commitments.For now, fans are waiting to see whether Nayanthara officially joins the film.
